pages.en:
—I am the only one who can still move freely.

Rider's Mystic Eyes have bound Archer and Tohsaka.

Then all I have to do is strike at the source—!
pages.mirrorMoon:
I’m the only one who can move.
Archer and Tohsaka are sealed by Rider’s mystic eyes.
Then I just need to get the main cause
!

pages.ja:
ライダーへ走る。
俺ではライダーを倒せずとも、一瞬ぐらいアーチャーから視線を外させる事は出来る……！
「……！？ バカな、正気か貴様……！ ライダーを直視するな……！」
アーチャーの声を振り切ってライダーへ走る。
アレが石化の魔眼なら、目を閉じてしまえばいい。
廊下は狭い。
ライダーまでの距離は把握している。
ライダーが俺を迎撃しようと、俺がデタラメにライダーを攻撃しようと、アーチャーならその隙になんとかできる筈だ……！
だが、足が凍った。
否、なんの比喩でもなく、本当に石化した。

pages.en:
I charge Rider.

I cannot defeat her, but I can at least draw her gaze from Archer for an instant…!

“…!? Fool! Have you lost your mind…!? Do not look directly at Rider…!”

Ignoring Archer's warning, I run on.

—If those are Mystic Eyes of Petrification, I need only close my eyes.

The corridor is narrow.

I know exactly how far away Rider stands.

Whether she moves to intercept me or I swing at her blindly, Archer—he'll seize the opening. I know he will…!

But my legs freeze.

No—not as a figure of speech. They truly turn to stone.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I run at Rider.
Even if I can’t beat her, I should at least be able to make her look away from Archer for a second…!
“…!? Are you stupid…!? Don’t look directly at her…!”
I ignore Archer’s voice and run at Rider.
If those are mystic eyes of petrification, I just need to close my eyes.
The hallway is small.
I know how much distance there is between us.
Rider can attack me or I can haphazardly attack her. Either way, Archer should be able to do something during that opening…!
But my legs freeze.
No, they are literally petrified.

pages.en:
“—Wh…”

Not only my legs.

The petrification climbs without pause, reaching my waist, hardening my chest, freezing both arms, and sealing my closed eyelids for all eternity.

“—y…?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Wh
”
It’s not just my legs.
The petrification does not stop and reaches my waist, hardens my chest, freezes my arms, and locks up my closed eyes forever.
“
Why?”

pages.ja:
「
愚かな。
目蓋を閉じる程度で私の魔眼を防ごうなど。肉眼であろうが心眼であろうが、今の私を見る事自体が呪いだというのに」
pages.jaRuby:

愚かな。
目蓋を閉じる程度で私の魔眼を防ごうなど。肉眼であろうが心眼であろうが、今の私を見る事自体が呪いだというのに」
pages.en:
“—Foolish.

“Did you imagine that merely closing your eyelids would defend against my Mystic Eyes? To behold me as I am now—whether with eyes of flesh or the mind's eye—is itself the curse.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
How foolish.
Trying to block my mystic eyes by merely closing your eyes. It doesn’t matter if you look at me with your naked eyes or your mind’s eye, as it is a curse to look at me in any way.”

石になった俺に知る術はない。

pages.en:
“——————”

Neither my throat nor my mouth will move.

…I can no longer perceive anything that happens in the outside world.

Even if Tohsaka were to scream—

Even if Archer were to shatter—

there would be no way for the stone I have become to know.
pages.mirrorMoon:

”
I can’t move my throat or my mouth.
…I can’t even tell what’s going on.
Even if Tohsaka screamed,
or if Archer fell to the ground…
I have no way to know, as I’m petrified.

pages.ja:
身体は硬化し、いずれ心も硬化するだろう。
……神話にある不老不死の三姉妹。
彼女たちと同じく、この身が変わる事は、永遠にない。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
My body has hardened. In time, my mind will harden as well.

…The three ageless, deathless sisters of myth.

Like theirs, my body will never change again—not for all eternity.
pages.mirrorMoon:
My body has turned to stone, and my mind is swiftly following.
…The three sisters from the legend are immortal.
Just like them, my body will never change.
